en.title: O&O ShutUp10 – The Anti‑Spy Tool for Windows 10 & 11
en.hook: Protect your Windows system from telemetry with O&O ShutUp10 – a lightweight privacy tool that lets you easily disable spying features.
key_takeaways: Disables Windows telemetry and tracking features with a simple interface
One‑click configuration to block privacy‑invasive apps and services
Free for personal use, no subscription required
